terms.comment: Our phrase, a kitchen clock: Morgan–Owens’s heading “timer” gives no Latin, and Traupman has no word. Culīnārius, of the kitchen, is Fronto’s adjective (Lewis & Short).

phrases.english: At last the kitchen timer rang.

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. timer (no Latin given).
